meta.title: The Part That Doesn't Fit: Indie Folk Song About Memory | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
An indie folk-pop song about a family story worn smooth by retelling, and a machine that learns what it costs to forget the rare. It gives you a chorus to carry: keep the part that doesn't fit.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down, reread, and return to what was left unsaid, and to keep the part that doesn't fit.

The Part That Doesn't Fit came from the research under an earlier song, Name Your Guess.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/the-part-that-doesnt-fit

copy.hook: Every retelling smooths a story a little, and the first thing lost is the odd detail that made it someone's. What would you keep?
copy.lead: An indie folk-pop song about a family story worn smooth by retelling, and a machine that learns what it costs to forget the rare. It gives you a chorus to carry: keep the part that doesn't fit.
copy.alt: A ribbon of braided amber and rose threads winds through indigo snowfall, with one crooked coral-gold strand glowing brightest. Then fading silver rings close in around a single jagged crystal, and finally a mosaic of mismatched crystals holds one gold crystal in its midst.
